messages.subject: Project Marlin - Disclosure Letter
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver, Deepa,

Disclosure letter attached against the Schedule 4 warranties. Specific disclosures cover the open-source components and pending Brightwater trade mark, the Halligan contractor claim (£18,400, disputed), the October MRR dip, the August data incident and the Pennine Mutual DPA re-signature, the customer #2 June 2026 renewal, and the EMI valuation point on the recent grants. Bundle index annexed.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
